summary: BIT ORIGIN Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting to be held on August 11, 2026. The meeting agenda includes four proposals: (1) changing the company name from BIT ORIGIN Ltd to SANGRIX INC., (2) increasing authorized share capital from US$15,000 to US$60,000,000 by creating billions of new ordinary shares, (3) adopting an amended memorandum to reflect the name change and capital increase, and (4) authorizing a share consolidation to be implemented at the board's discretion within two years. These are routine corporate governance proposals, not a special situation event.
